args.title: Freight Pricing & Companion Summary (2026)
args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady; fuel surcharges now adjust weekly in line with diesel prices.
- Shippers who diversified volume across three carriers (rather than consolidating with one or two) achieved the lowest overall freight costs.
- Together, the pieces suggest a near-term strategy: lock in contract rates to hedge against surcharge volatility, and spread volume across multiple carriers to capture competitive pricing.
